svg.title: GuitarDAWLiteOS M2/M3 bench wiring diagram (ADC-as-master topology)
svg.desc: Nano ESP32 generates 12.288 MHz MCLK; the CJMCU-1808 ADC masters the I2S bus (BCK+LRCK) feeding the Pi 5 as slave and the PCM5102A DAC; TL072 front-end on a CopperSound board with Gator 9V; three power domains, one star ground.
svg.text: Bench wiring — ADC masters the bus (clock pivot 2026-07-10)
power: own USB-C(never 5 V into VIN)D2 —[33 Ω]→ MCLK 12.288 MHzTWO GND wires → star(one twisted with MCLK)
KEEP D2→D3 link (tap before the 33 Ω)= permanent MCLK health readout

SCK ← Nano D2 via 33 Ω (12.288 MHz)MD0, MD1 → 3.3 V rail (MASTER, 256 fs → 48 kHz)FMT → GND (I²S format) — strap all three BEFORE power-on+5V ← J8 p2 via 10 Ω (+470 µF ∥ 0.1 µF here) — ADC ONLY, never the DAC3.3 pin ← Pi J8 pin 1 (digital VDD — NEVER 5 V here, 4 V abs max)BOTH GND pins: left → star · right → return with BCK/LRC/OUT
Drives out: BCK 3.072 MHz · LRC 48 kHz · OUT (data)
LIN ← front-end (Rs 1 k + Ca 1 nF right at this pad)
– → star ground · RIN: leave open (rev-B tape return)
watch batch quality: some ship with wrong solder jumpers

J8 p12 GPIO18 ← BCK (ADC drives it)J8 p35 GPIO19 ← LRC (ADC drives it)J8 p38 GPIO20 ← OUT (capture data)J8 p40 GPIO21 → DAC DIN (playback)J8 p2 = 5 V out · p1 = 3.3 V out · p6 = star GNDpower: official 27 W USB-C PD
cap/play stay 0 until ADC is wired + clocked = normal
BCK + LCK ← same ADC-driven busDIN ← Pi J8 p40 (GPIO21)SCK → GND (internal PLL locks off BCK)VIN ← J8 p2 RAW (NOT via the 10 Ω)GND → star groundpads: FLT=L · DEMP=L · XSMT=H(!) · FMT=L
TL072 front-end — CopperSound DIY breadboard (9 V domain)

Gator 9 V PSU → CopperSound DC jack (both Boss-style center-negative — polarity handled)Guitar → input jack → Cin 0.1 µF → Rbias 1 M @ VBIAS 4.9 V (R1 10 k / R2 12 k) → TL072 buffer→ ×3 gain (Rg 10 k, Rf 10 k + trim) → Cout 1 µF → output jack → cable → ADC LIN padRs 1 k + Ca 1 nF live at the ADC end of the cable, NOT on the pedal board
9 V feeds ONLY the TL072 — never near the ADC · explicit GND wire to star (not just cable sleeve)

1. Pi 27 W USB-C → Pi. J8 p2 (5 V) SPLITS: branch A → DAC VIN direct; branch B → 10 Ω → ADC +5V (ADC only!). J8 p1 (3.3 V) → ADC digital VDD + MD0/MD1 straps (direct wire, no regulator).2. Nano ESP32 own USB-C · 3. Gator 9 V → TL072 only. Power up in that order; power down in reverse.STAR GROUND = Pi J8 pin 6 (ONE DC point): ADC GND + "–" pad · DAC GND · Nano GND ×2 · CopperSound GNDPaired/twisted HF returns alongside MCLK and the BCK/LRC/OUT bundle are REQUIRED — they are not "islands".NEVER run the DAC through the 10 Ω: 34 mA × 10 Ω = 340 mV → ADC VCC 4.41 V on a sagged rail, under its 4.5 V minimum.
